name: OrcaSlicer MCP
description: Work a running OrcaSlicer with AI: load models, arrange the plate, tune settings, slice, and understand the result through slice breakdowns, setting explanations, and physics checks. Talks to OrcaSlicer on localhost or a host you configure and, for the printer tools, makes read-only requests to your printer; no cloud calls from this server.
author: maxellis

deploymentOptions.description: Run straight from PyPI with uv; no install step.

ORCA_API_TOKEN.description: Remote API token from the OrcaSlicer MCP build (Preferences -> Remote API)

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Start here: a snapshot of the OrcaSlicer session (build or plugin, project, active presets and their unsaved edits, whether the last slice still holds); for slice numbers use get_slice_status.

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Read the current value of settings (all, or only `keys`); with `keys`, `about` also says what each one means, its unit, range and choices.

tools.name: set_config
tools.description: Change settings on the open project as unsaved edits, all or nothing; a key set to null goes back to its saved preset value; use apply_and_slice to also slice, or edit_preset to change a saved preset.

tools.name: slice
tools.description: Start a slice and return at once without waiting; use slice_and_wait when you want the finished time and filament in the same call.

tools.name: get_slice_status
tools.description: Read the state, time and filament of the current or last slice, and whether it is out of date; for the warnings alone use get_slice_warnings.

tools.name: get_slice_warnings
tools.description: Read only the warnings and errors of the last slice and whether it still holds; the quick check that a fix cleared a warning.

tools.name: get_slice_breakdown
tools.description: Read where the time and filament of the last slice go, per feature (walls, infill, support), with a check for speeds capped by the flow limit.

tools.name: cancel_slice
tools.description: Stop a running slice, or clear a slice stuck in 'slicing'; safe to call when nothing is running.

tools.name: slice_and_wait
tools.description: Slice the current plate and wait for the finished time, filament and warnings; the usual way to slice (slice returns at once instead).

tools.name: apply_and_slice
tools.description: Change settings and slice in one call, returning both; use set_config and then slice_and_wait to keep the steps apart.

tools.name: compare_settings
tools.description: Slice once per value of a single setting and return the raw numbers, putting the value back after; compare_slices adds deltas and a verdict.

tools.name: compare_slices
tools.description: Slice under 2-8 named combinations of settings and compare time, filament and warnings with ready-made deltas and a verdict, putting the settings back after; compare_settings only sweeps one setting.

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: List the objects in the project with their ids, names, sizes, placement and plate; the object tools take these ids.

tools.name: set_object_config
tools.description: Change settings for one object only, all or nothing; use set_config to change them for the whole plate.

tools.name: duplicate_object
tools.description: Add one copy of an object next to it on the plate; call it again for more copies.

tools.name: delete_object
tools.description: Remove one object from the plate by id; this cannot be undone through these tools.

tools.name: transform_object
tools.description: Move, rotate or scale one object by id; use move_object_to_plate to change its plate, or arrange_plate to tidy the whole plate.

tools.name: arrange_plate
tools.description: Let OrcaSlicer pack every object on the unlocked plates (Arrange all); use transform_object to move just one.

tools.name: auto_orient
tools.description: Let OrcaSlicer turn every object to its best printing orientation; use transform_object to rotate one by a set angle.

tools.name: list_plates
tools.description: List the project's plates with their objects and which one is current; the plate tools take the 0-based index shown here.

tools.name: get_printer_slots
tools.description: Read the filament trays of an Elegoo Centauri Carbon 2 with a CANVAS unit; only for that printer, and slow (up to about 18 s).

tools.name: get_filament_slot_mapping
tools.description: Show which CANVAS tray each filament would print from on the next Send (Elegoo Centauri Carbon 2 only); read-only.

tools.name: set_filament_slot_mapping
tools.description: Choose which CANVAS tray each filament prints from on the next Send (Elegoo Centauri Carbon 2 only); it starts nothing.

tools.name: add_plate
tools.description: Add an empty plate, like the toolbar's Add plate button, so parts can print separately.

tools.name: select_plate
tools.description: Make a plate the current one, so slicing, G-code, renders and slice status act on it.

tools.name: delete_plate
tools.description: Delete a plate; the objects on it are parked beside the bed, not deleted.

tools.name: move_object_to_plate
tools.description: Move an object onto another plate by its index; simpler than transform_object for changing plates.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Read the open project as a file (name, path, unsaved changes); check it before save_project, open_project or new_project.

tools.name: save_project
tools.description: Save the open project as a .3mf with its plates and settings (File > Save or Save As); save_gcode saves the sliced G-code instead.

tools.name: open_project
tools.description: Open a saved .3mf project with its plates and settings, replacing the open one; load_model only adds a model's geometry.

tools.name: open_recent_project
tools.description: Open an entry of File > Recent by its position in list_recent_projects; open_project takes a path instead.

tools.name: new_project
tools.description: Start a new, empty project (File > New Project) without a dialog.

tools.name: list_recent_projects
tools.description: List File > Recent, most recent first, with the index that open_recent_project takes.

tools.name: forget_recent_project
tools.description: Remove an entry from File > Recent, or clear the list; the file on disk stays.

tools.name: browse_projects
tools.description: List the .3mf project files in one folder on the OrcaSlicer machine; list_recent_projects shows File > Recent instead.

tools.name: move_project_file
tools.description: Move or rename a .3mf project file on disk; the window follows when it is the open project.

tools.name: delete_project_file
tools.description: Delete a .3mf project file from disk for good; forget_recent_project only takes it off File > Recent.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Check whether arranging or orienting is still running; wait for idle before reading positions or slicing.

tools.name: watch_events
tools.description: Listen to OrcaSlicer's live events (slices, setting changes, projects opened) for a few seconds.

tools.name: find_config_keys
tools.description: Find setting keys that contain a piece of text, from the live settings; search_settings also matches labels and descriptions, offline.

tools.name: diagnose_plate
tools.description: Start here when a plate won't slice or fit: status, objects, bed and skirt or brim settings and slice warnings in one call.

tools.name: check_placement
tools.description: Estimate before slicing whether every object, with its skirt or brim, fits the bed; get_slice_warnings has the exact verdict after.

tools.name: consult
tools.description: Look up curated slicing advice and saved notes for a goal or symptom; call it before choosing settings.

tools.name: check_profile_physics
tools.description: Check the live settings, plus optional proposed changes, against flow, temperature, geometry and cooling limits; run it before save_preset.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save a short note for future sessions (about a printer, the user or a project); consult finds it again.

tools.name: describe_setting
tools.description: Explain one setting from its key: label, meaning, type, unit, allowed range and choices; works offline.

tools.name: search_settings
tools.description: Find settings by words in their key, label or description, offline; describe_setting then explains one.

tools.name: load_model
tools.description: Load a model file (.stl, .obj, .3mf geometry, .step) from the OrcaSlicer machine onto the plate; open_project opens a saved project instead.

tools.name: select_preset
tools.description: Switch the active print, filament or printer preset; without a filament slot this drops every unsaved edit.

tools.name: save_preset
tools.description: Save the current settings as a named user preset; edit_preset changes a stored preset in one step instead.

tools.name: list_presets
tools.description: List the print, filament and printer presets: the user's own and the selected ones, or all with include_system.

tools.name: set_layer_height
tools.description: Turn adaptive layer height on or off for one object; set_height_range sets a fixed height over a Z band instead.

tools.name: set_height_range
tools.description: Set a layer height over a Z band of one object; set_layer_height makes the whole object adaptive instead.

tools.name: get_preset_config
tools.description: Read every setting of a named preset without selecting it; get_config reads the live settings.

tools.name: delete_preset
tools.description: Delete one of the user's presets (never a system preset or the selected one).

tools.name: edit_preset
tools.description: Change a stored preset and save it under the same name, after the physics check; set_config changes only the open project.

tools.name: rename_preset
tools.description: Rename one of the user's presets; the renamed preset becomes the selected one.

tools.name: get_gcode
tools.description: Return the last slice's G-code as text; save_gcode writes it to a file and records the slice.

tools.name: describe_plate
tools.description: Describe from the G-code how each sliced part stands, touches the bed, overhangs, is supported and where its seams are; needs a finished slice.

tools.name: save_gcode
tools.description: Save the last slice's G-code to a file and record the slice so the print can be learned from later; hand the path to the printer tools.

tools.name: recall_prints
tools.description: Recall how past prints of this model turned out and with which settings; call it before slicing.

tools.name: render_plate
tools.description: Render a picture of the plate: the models before slicing (editor) or the toolpaths after it (preview).

tools.name: get_printer_status
tools.description: Read what the 3D printer is doing now (state, temperatures, job progress, problems); wait_for_printer waits for a point in a print.

tools.name: wait_for_printer
tools.description: Wait until the printer is heated, printing, past the first layer or finished, checking every 5 seconds.

tools.name: list_print_history
tools.description: List how recent prints on the printer ended against the slicer's estimates (Klipper only); recall_prints looks up one model's past prints.

tools.name: check_printer_match
tools.description: Check the active OrcaSlicer profile against the printer's own Klipper settings (nozzle, bed, speeds, temperatures); warnings only.

prompts.name: slice-a-model
prompts.description: Guided load -> check -> slice -> read-back workflow for one model file.

prompts.name: optimize-print-time
prompts.description: Data-driven print-time reduction from a real slice breakdown, never adjectives alone.

prompts.name: edit-preset-safely
prompts.description: Preset change with the physics gate: consult -> set_config -> check_profile_physics -> save_preset.

overview.summary: MCP server that lets Claude or any MCP client operate a real, running OrcaSlicer: load models, arrange plates, tune ~800 settings with a physics sanity gate, slice, and read per-feature results back. Requires the OrcaSlicer MCP build (fork with an embedded, token-authenticated local control API).
